provenance.classification: Synthetic original timer1 FE70 dispatch; bank0/noIC4, masked CPU IRQ/FIRQ, injected saved-U frame and pending timer1 flag from hardware control02/latch1 (IRQ disabled to prevent recursive short-period IRQ after ANDCC). SWI2 handler and ROM option unpatched. Stop before28FE

excluded.reason: Initial latch1/control42 experiment allowed repeated physical IRQs after native ANDCC, preempting the selected isolated path. Owned run aborted; accepted experiment keeps the flag but disables timer1 IRQ with control02.
